verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-2 review confirms the prior approval. The generator derives `queue_dropped` exclusively from its own refusal log, publishes the zero census unconditionally, and keeps refused inputs distinct from accepted-row totals and display truncation. The page treats a positive integral refusal count as loss, renders full and partial loss clearly, and excludes affected snapshots from the queue-depth trend; absent, malformed, legacy, or collector-forged values do not fabricate or suppress generator-side loss. The executed page scenarios and generator checks independently cover empty, accepted, fully refused, partially refused, capped-warning, legacy, malformed, and forged-count cases with non-colliding expectations. I found no correctness, soundness, test-vacuity, security, or injection issue in the diff.
